stories.title: Josh Jacobs scores twice as Packers dispatch Panthers
stories.summary: Carolina made a game of it late, but Green Bay held on for the Thursday night win.

stories.title: Packers WR Watson returns to play with broken rib after trip to hospital
stories.summary: Christian Watson was determined to get back on the field Thursday despite coughing up blood and having to take an ambulance ride to get an X-ray and a CT scan.

stories.title: Packers' Jacobs says TD celebration was ode to gospel song, not mocking arrest
stories.summary: The Packers' Josh Jacobs said he was surprised his first-half TD celebration was perceived by some as mocking his May arrest, saying it was an ode to a gospel song.

stories.title: 'Locked in' Gray, Dream hold off Valkyries, force first Finals Game 7
stories.summary: Allisha Gray scored 23 points as the Dream held off a late rally for an 80-69 victory over the Valkyries to force a historic Game 7 of the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Red Wings suspend Larkin as team explores trade options; players keen to move on
stories.summary: The Red Wings announced Thursday that star forward Dylan Larkin has been suspended without pay after informing the team he no longer wanted to play for Detroit.
